title.narrative: EU Green Agenda in Serbia: biodiversity and water for climate resilience
EU:s Gröna Agenda i Serbien: biodiversitet, vatten och klimatresiliens

description.narrative:
The main objective of the project is to improve governance and management of ecosystems through increased capacities for planning, implementation and enforcement of nature, water and climate policies by 2026.
The Project will support the EU environmental reform and efficient, inclusive and sustainable implementation the EU Green Agenda in Serbia. The Project will give focus to biodiversity, water and wetlands and climate resilience, by strengthening policy and base-conditions, supporting further work on Nature Based Solutions (NbS) through pilot projects and promote opportunities for mobilization and scale-up of climate and biodiversity financing. The Project aims at building capacity, cross-sectorial cooperation a societal dialogue as well as building strong partnerships between the public sector, private companies and civil society, to accelerate green transformation.
The project has been amended in May 2025 to include additional activities. These activities which will practically demonstrate the functional implementation of ecosystem services, their valorisation and their integration into development planning. Additionally, the establishment of an assessment system for management of protected areas will improve the monitoring and follow up of protected areas' operations.

Huvudsyftet med projektet är att förbättra styrning och förvaltning av ekosystem genom ökad kapacitet för planering, genomförande och upprätthållande av natur-, vatten- och klimatpolitik i Serbien senast 2026.
Projektet kommer att stödja EU:s miljöreform och ett effektivt, inkluderande och hållbart genomförande av EU:s gröna agenda i Serbien. Projektet kommer att ge fokus till biologisk mångfald, vatten och våtmarker och klimatmotståndskraft, genom att stärka policy och basvillkor, stödja fortsatt arbete med Nature Based Solutions (NbS) genom pilotprojekt och främja möjligheter för mobilisering och uppskalning av klimat- och biologisk mångfaldsfinansiering. Projektet syftar till att bygga kapacitet, tvärsektoriellt samarbete och en samhällelig dialog samt bygga starka partnerskap mellan offentlig sektor, privata företag och civilsamhället, för att påskynda en grön omställning.

title.narrative: Amendment agreement nr 2 with UNDP for contribution nr 15055
Decision on Amendment nr 2 of Contribution nr 15055

description.narrative:
In the second full year of implementaton, the project achieved planned results and progress towards the project goal. Notable results for the period include:
-The project successfully implemented the Challenge Call for Innovative Solutions for the Protection, Preservation and Revitalization of Wetland Habitats, one of the key components providing direct support to practical measures for improving wetlands in Serbia. Twelve project proposals have entered the acceleration phase, with the decision on final selection of those to receive financial support to take place in the first quarter of 2025, followed immediately by their implementation. - The project produced the first draft of the second bylaw planned by the project the Decree on Appropriate Assessment. The first draft was submitted to the Ministry of Environmental Protection for further processing and organisation of the consultations with other relevant stakeholders in early 2025. - The project has contracted the company (GSC Systems) which began the process of upgrading the field research application (TERENSKA) with elements relevant for wetland conservation, as well as the enhancement of the information systems for biodiversity data of both the Institute for Nature Conservation of Serbia (INCS) and the Provincial Institute for Nature Conservation (PINC). Furthermore, the project acquired additional IT equipment for these two institutions in 2024, to further facilitate the collection, transfer and storage processes for biodiversity data. - The project team has formally engaged the UNDP Tech Cell to develop a wetland conservation-oriented citizen science application and it began work in 2024. - Following a revision (reallocation) of project budget, approved by the Project Board in July 2024, further funds were made available for the development of the first National Wetland Inventory (NWI) for Serbia, for which the UNDP project team produced Terms of Reference and published a call for offers, with the work expected to start in the first quarter of 2025. - The project entrusted the implementation of the communication plan developed last year to the company New Media Team following an open competitive procurement process. The year 2024 saw the launch of the public awareness raising campaign entitled "Ove nije samo bara"/This is not just a pond, with New Media Team developing several promotional materials, including key visuals, newsletters and social media posts for the campaign with the slogan. The campaign will continue throughout 2025.
In short, 2024 was an important year for establishing several key processes that shall achieve the project results, with special emphasis on the Challenge Call process, biodiversity data portal and information system development for two institutes, NWI development, communications and on the ground initiatives, thus contributing to the stated mission of improving the conditions for wetland and nature conservation in Serbia.
